label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Austin Championship lead
items.text: Trace Crowe leads the Austin Championship presented by Compliance Solutions at 13-under after two rounds, with Kevin Yu one shot behind at -12 and Brian Harman and Kristoffer Ventura tied at -11.

items.headline: Hatton leads Dubai event
items.text: Tyrrell Hatton leads the DP World Tour Championship at 9-under after shooting 4-under 68, while Rory McIlroy slipped to 5-under and trails by four shots, denting his chances for an eighth Race to Dubai title.

items.headline: Van Rooyen on LIV returns
items.text: Erik van Rooyen insists former LIV players must return to the PGA Tour by going through Q-school, opposing special treatment and emphasizing fairness in the qualification process.
